messages:
Kayla: Heads up — found a parity mismatch in the Go SDK batching helper that broke the sampleapp rerank flow when we switched infra.
Devon: What mismatch?
Kayla: Helper pads vectors to the next multiple of 512 (so 1024 -> 1536 in some paths). Encoder outputs 1024, but helper then pads to 1536 when batch_size triggers pad_to_multiple. Python/JS pad to model.dim so CI missed it.
Priya: That will silently shift everything. Does the server accept different lengths?
Kayla: Server currently accepts, but the reranker consumer assumes returned ordering and shapes match model.dim and crashes during unbatching: 
```
ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 1572864 into shape (8,1024)
```
Luis: Two problems then: client-side pad policy and server-side permissive acceptance. Short-term: change helper to pad_to_model_dim, not pad_to_multiple. Long-term: server should validate and reject mismatched dims with a clear error code.
Nina: Also noticed response element ordering changed after a LB patch — some nodes return {"id":...,"embedding":...} and others {"embedding":...,"id":...}. Sampleapp mapped by index not id so this caused silent misalignment even when dims were correct.
Kayla: Repro script (tiny):
```
# repro_go_embed.sh
go run ./samples/repro_embed.go --model redwood-embed-1 --batch 8
# prints helper emitted dims per item
```
Devon: Auth story: token refresh race causes the SDK to retry the full batch without an idempotency key. If that retry hits a node that reorders fields differently you can end up with duplicated rerank effects and misaligned mappings.
Priya: Oof. So fixes: (1) SDK pad_to_model_dim across all languages, (2) add server-side EMBEDDING_DIM_MISMATCH 400 + metric, (3) normalize response field ordering in API contract and enforce on gateway, (4) add idempotency header support for /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank to prevent duplicate side effects.
Luis: I created an issue and test matrix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2567 (integration tests for 512/1024/2048 across Go/Python/JS/Rust).
Kayla: PR for Go SDK submitted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/92 — changes pad behaviour and adds debug logging original_dim -> final_dim.
Nina: I'll add a small compatibility note to the onboarding docs so sampleapps know to map by id, not by index.
infra-bot: staging deploy scheduled at 03:30 UTC :rocket:
Devon: Also adding an SDK integration test to assert that any emitted embedding length == model.dim, failing fast in CI so we catch regressions.
Priya: Filed follow-up for idempotency header on platform: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2570. Marked P1 for DX squad.
Luis: Metrics/alert: embedding.dim.mismatch.counter and alert on > 3 in 5m.
Kayla: After merge and staging canary I'll report results here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
